# Draft:Ron Vance Howard

Ron Vance Howard (commonly known as Vance Howard) is an American financial advisor, portfolio manager, entrepreneur, and former elected official from Huntsville, Texas. He is the founder, Chief Executive Officer, and Portfolio Manager of Howard Capital Management, Inc., a fee-only registered investment advisory firm, and previously served multiple terms on the Huntsville City Council.
Early life
Howard is a native of Huntsville, Texas. Detailed information regarding his early life and formal education has not been widely reported in independent sources.
Business career
Howard began his entrepreneurial career in 1988 with the founding of Delta Waste Services, a waste management company which he sold in 1992. That same year, he entered the financial services industry with the formation of Chartered Financial Services, Inc.
In 1999, Howard founded Howard Capital Management, Inc., a fee-only Registered Investment Advisor headquartered in Roswell, Georgia. He serves as the firm’s Chief Executive Officer and Portfolio Manager. The firm provides investment research, tactical asset allocation strategies, and professionally managed portfolios for individuals, advisors, and institutions.
Howard’s executive role and professional background have been documented in independent financial industry directories.
Political and civic service
Howard was elected four times to the Huntsville City Council and served twice as mayor pro tempore. During his tenure, he held leadership positions including Chairman of the City Finance Committee and Chairman of the 911 Emergency Service for Huntsville and Walker County.
Independent local news coverage has identified Howard as a former Huntsville City Council member and mayor pro tempore in reporting on community redevelopment projects, including the reopening of the historic Café Texan in downtown Huntsville.
In addition to his elected service, Howard has been active in civic organizations and previously served as President of the Huntsville Rotary Club.
Other ventures
Howard and his family own and operate the Bar C Ranch in Madisonville, Texas, which focuses on raising registered Texas Longhorn cattle.
He has also been involved in historic preservation and redevelopment projects in Huntsville, including the acquisition and restoration of the historic Café Texan building, which now operates as a history museum and library.
The historic Café Texan’s reopening was covered by *The Huntsville Item*, noting the role of Howard in restoring the landmark.
Personal life
Howard is married and has children. He has described interests that include travel, cycling, kayaking, scuba diving, and hiking.
